question: Should this Feishu media fallback PR require real Feishu/Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client proof as a proof override?
rationale: The code shape matches the existing fallback contract, but external PR policy treats mocked-client output as insufficient real behavior proof unless a maintainer explicitly owns the live-transport proof gap.

options.title: Require Real Feishu Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup before merge.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the mocked seam proof because the patch reuses the already-shipped text/card fallback helper.

options.title: Choose Another Candidate
options.body: If maintainers prefer the other open same-root branch, pause this PR until one candidate has a clear proof and landing path.

recommendation.title: Require Real Feishu Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a Feishu live-platform proof decision, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` lists `sliverp` for Feishu among the Chinese channels.
